feature: Roll the cut between two clips
summary: The cut where one clip ends and the next starts now rolls to the playhead from its right-click and from Clip > Roll Edit to Playhead, just like a cut inside one clip: the first clip grows by what the second gives up, and nothing after them moves.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no switch changed from its default. Two clips butted on V1, each with some footage trimmed off at the cut (W on the first, Q on the second).

try.do: Put two clips end to end on V1 and trim a little off each side of where they meet.
Park the playhead a second past the cut, then right-click the cut between the clips.
Press Command Z once, then Shift Command Z.
Click the cut to pick it and choose Clip > Roll Edit to Playhead in the menu bar.
Move the playhead far from the cut and right-click it again.

evaluate: After the roll, does the first clip end and the second start exactly on the playhead, with the second clip still ending where it did?
Does each clip's sound stay linked under its own clip after the roll?
When the playhead is further than the spare footage allows, is a dimmed row clear enough, or would you rather it rolled as far as it can?
Does the roll on a cut between clips feel the same as the roll on a cut inside one clip?
rough: No mock draws the right-click menu on a cut; the row sits under the transition rows, as it already does on a cut inside one clip.
A roll past the spare footage is refused (row dimmed) rather than rolling as far as it can, the same rule the cut inside one clip already had.
